mintAuthority.summary: FUSD has four canonical issuer-native deployments on Ethereum, Avalanche, Sonic, and Monad. FinChain's gateway retains an admin-only arbitrary local mint path, while CCIP pools and TokenBridgeSender are bridge machinery reviewed under bridgeRouteRisk. One EOA controls every token and gateway DEFAULT_ADMIN role, the issuer-owned pools, and the shared zero-delay ProxyAdmin, so it can grant minters or replace mint-critical logic immediately.

controls.label: FinChain issuer-operated mint authority
controls.evidence: FinChain documents eligible-customer issuance and redemption through its centralized operating stack. The backend controls an uncapped gateway/admin path and the token role administrator across all four chains, so it can originate additional issuance rather than merely consume a fixed allowance.

Continuous issuer reserve reconciliation and prudential Bermuda supervision remain the reviewed annotations; no independent dated reserve attestation was found.
